meta.title: E6 re-base triage: 1.21.11 behaviour-port fixes -> 1.21.5-1.21.10
meta.source_range: 07e3acb9 (1.21.11 mechanical publish) -> 2856b179 (behaviour tip incl. D2 fix)
meta.method: 249 classification units (168 item/structural commits + 81 A-batch commit-file pairs). Each unit classified shared/specific/uncertain from its diff + item TRIAGE file + PORT-NOTES, with jar verification (javap against the named 1.21.6-1.21.10 jars, string scans of the obfuscated 1.21.5 jar) where the classification needed a vanilla fact. Applicability of shared units measured by matching hunk old/new signatures against the target tree on main: applies = pre-change code present, already-fixed = post-change code present, differs = neither form present, uncertain = mixed applies+already-fixed hunks (partially applied, needs review). Unit status is the worst file status; hunk counts are the finer picture. Excluded from classification: the 6 regenerated tables, pins/, work-items.json, PORT-NOTES, docs.
scope_notes: Copper-golem changes (items 86, 109, 446) apply only to 1.21.9/1.21.10; the golem is absent in 1.21.5-1.21.8 (N/A there, not differs). Item 446 is classified uncertain for this reason.
Item 16's copper-chest Christmas arm only engages in 1.21.9+; inert in 1.21.5-1.21.8.
Item 751 (villager_trades) is uncertain: the mechanism is shared but the 297+94 listing tables are 1.21.11 data; each version needs its own tables from its jar.
Item 93 (foal scale) is uncertain: the 0.5 foal scale is shared but the Horse/ZombieHorse -1.0 ctor malus is a 1.21.11 addition; propagating the malus to E6 would be wrong.
Item 155 is uncertain: the lightmap rewrite is shared but the EnvironmentAttributes removals are 1.21.11-specific (that system was added in 1.21.11).
The trees fix (56e86819, origin 1.21.7) is a separate 1.21.7-origin shared fix, listed under trees_fix; it also applies to 1.20.5 and 1.21.4 (outside the re-base range) with a per-version check.
The water fix (ee7ab396, 1.21.7) is NOT in this triage: it is carried over separately (fix/e6-water-carryover, paused) and 1.21.11 itself carries the same bug.

shared.reason: ComponentMap.set returns the prototype value (null when absent) instead of throwing on an unsanitized removal, matching 1.21.11's Optional patch map; verified via javap that 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 also have no DataComponentPatch$Removed class, so the Optional form is shared across E6.

Item 263: loom dye/pattern slots accept any DyeItem / PROVIDES_BANNER_PATTERNS item instead of the 26.x-only #loom_dyes/#loom_patterns tags, which no 1.21.x version has; the replacement checks are the long-standing 1.21.x form.
Item 154: test-instance bounds are unpadded because test-instance padding is 26.x-only; no E6 version has padding, so the unpadded bounds propagate.
Item 154: removes the padding field and all padding math from test definitions and structure boxes; padding is 26.x-only, so the removal propagates to all E6 versions.
Item 263: frogspawn placement requires water below, dropping the 26.x-only #supports_frogspawn tag gate; the water-below rule is the classic 1.21.x FrogspawnBlock.mayPlaceOn form.

Makes dye_from_name public so horizon-client (creatures.rs) can use it for the shared item-263 fix (dye checks without the 1.21.11-absent minecraft:dye component); no behaviour change alone, but it propagates with that fix.

Item 320: removes baby-horse sound branches (entity.baby_horse.* exists in neither version; 26.1 added entity.horse.*_baby), so babies use adult events at 1.5x pitch — the 1.21.x form, shared across E6.
Item 345: llama coat textures have no llama_ prefix and no baby variants in 1.21.x (both are 26.x additions); babies wear the adult coat, the same in every E6 version.
Item 354: particles in unloaded chunks get light 0 (26.x returns sky 15); Particle.getLightColor returning 0 for unloaded chunks is the classic 1.21.x form.
Item 361: placed-feature expansion now covers flower/no_bonemeal_flower/random_patch (RandomPatchFeature implementation); these feature types exist unchanged across E6.
Item 361: deletes the 26.x-only minecraft:spike feature type (SpikeFeature); no E6 version has it, so the deletion propagates.
Item 383: breeze maluses use the classic 1.21.x PathType names (DangerTrapdoor/DamageFire, -1.0); the 26.x Fire/OnTopOfTrapdoor names are the novelty, so the 1.21.x form propagates.
Item 383: parrot maluses use the classic 1.21.x PathType names (DangerFire/DamageFire, -1.0); the 26.x Fire/FireInNeighbor names are the novelty, so the 1.21.x form propagates.
Item 383: strider maluses use the classic 1.21.x PathType names (DangerFire/DamageFire, 0.0); the 26.x Fire/FireInNeighbor names are the novelty, so the 1.21.x form propagates.

Item 401: DiskConfiguration decodes the rule-based record form (fallback + rules, no type field) and places unconditionally, because 1.21.x has no typed rule_based_state_provider (26.1 promoted it); the record form is the 1.21.x form across E6.
Item 407: a baby husk inherits Zombie's scaled dimensions (0.3 x 0.975, eye 0.93); Husk's own BABY_DIMENSIONS override is a 26.1 addition, so no E6 version has it.

Item 11: removes the preedit overlay entirely (PreeditEvent/IMEPreeditOverlay/preedit.png are 26.x-only); 1.21.x IME input goes through charTyped with the OS composition window, the same in every E6 version.

Item 14: moves the impulse context onto Player only (1-arg setIgnoreFallDamageFromCurrentImpulse, grace 40) and ports the LAN interaction guards; verified via javap that 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 also keep the impulse context on Player (LivingEntity has none), and the ServerPlayer guards are classic 1.21.x rules.
Item 19: baby piglin ears flap around 30 degrees like adults (literal 0.5235988); the 5-degree baby angle came from 26.1's BabyPiglinModel split, which no 1.21.x version has.

Item 23: deletes the 26.x-only age-lock mechanic (verified: no AGE_LOCK in 1.21.7/1.21.10 AgeableMob), shifts ageable entity-data indices down 1 as a consequence, drops the leash clause from requiresCustomPersistence (verified: it is just isPassenger() in 1.21.7/1.21.10), and restores magma bubble columns — all 26.x-vs-1.21.x differences, the same across E6.

Item 29: the stonecutter resets its scroll only when the input leaves (displayRecipes goes false); resetting on every container change is the 26.x behaviour, and the input-leaves-only form is the classic StonecutterScreen rule.

Item 34: baby piglins are half their adult box (0.3 x 0.975, eyes 0.97) and StartHuntingHoglin gates on the bare presence of any visible adult piglin; the absolute baby dims and the hunted-recently filter are both 26.1 novelties.
Item 44: restores the classic /time (set/add/query) and drops the 26.x /swing command and clock/marker system; the classic /time shape is unchanged across all 1.21.x.

Item 49: minecart texture at the flat entity/minecart path and the TNT flash computed from the interpolated fuse (fuseRemainingInTicks); both are the classic 1.21.x forms, the subdir path and raw-fuse flash being 26.x changes.

Item 54: cursor moves fire the chat responder (EditBox.moveCursorTo ends in onValueChange) and all three edit paths run edited() per the 1.21.11 rules; the 26.1 updateTextPosition ending is the novelty, and EditBox behaviour is stable across 1.21.x.

Item 59: hanging-moss bonemeal has no build-height guard (26.x added one) and dry vegetation binds the dry_vegetation_may_place_on tag (26.1 renamed it supports_dry_vegetation); both 1.21.x forms hold across E6 (dry vegetation itself dates to 1.21.5).

Item 65: postProcessGeneration skips LiquidBlocks entirely (fluid tick only; 26.1 also gave them a block tick and shape update), with bubble columns still forming via MagmaBlock/SoulSandBlock updateShape; the skip is the classic 1.21.x chunk post-processing form.

Item 69: removes the 26.x Adult/Baby model split (one concrete model per species, BABY_TRANSFORMER for babies) across seven species' animations (rabbit procedural hop, fox single form, etc.); the single-model form is the 1.21.x form across E6.
Item 80: drops the 0.01 RENDERING_OFFSET inset from the world-border renderer; the offset exists in neither version's renderer (a Rust invention), so removing it is correct in every E6 version.

Item 86: copper-golem antenna-block placement (model drops 2.25, statues turn Y 180 and sit on the antenna, skulls/banners/chests turn around as well as upside down); verified via javap that BlockDecorationLayer bytecode is identical in 1.21.9, 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 and the -2.25 drop matches in 1.21.9/1.21.10. Applies to 1.21.9/1.21.10 only — no copper golem exists in 1.21.5-1.21.8.

Item 94: map data at the classic data/map_<id>.dat paths with the counter in data/idcounts.dat, and the tracked-decoration limit is >= 256; the data/minecraft/maps layout and the > limit are 26.x changes.

Item 99: drops the 26.x wide-mob diagonal gate (BIG_MOBS_CLOSE_TO_DANGER) and makes the swim BREACH test read the candidate cell itself for WATER-pathfindability; both are the classic 1.21.x pathfinding forms.

Item 107: biome spawns parse from the classic spawners JSON (type/weight/minCount/maxCount, NaturalSpawner always draws) instead of the 26.x gameplay attribute, and tall-grass upper halves tint from the block below; both are classic 1.21.x forms.

Item 115: baby pandas sit like adults (no BabyPandaModel in 1.21.x; babies run PandaModel.setupAnim on the BABY_TRANSFORMER layer) and eating crumbs draw the height offset before the x offset; both are the classic 1.21.x forms.
Item 122: the spectator menu's team-icon colour square fades with the menu alpha, as TeamSelectionItem.renderIcon does; classic SpectatorGui behaviour, stable across 1.21.x.

Item 127: warns on low disk space after every integrated save (IntegratedServer.saveEverything calls warnOnLowDiskSpace), with dedicated servers staying quiet; the classic 1.21.x form, the 26.x sendLowDiskSpaceWarning being the refactor.

Item 131: a worker-thread panic is logged, not reported, because 1.21.11's onThreadException has no delayed crash to relay (relayDelayCrash is 26.1-only); the log-and-carry-on form is the classic 1.21.x Util behaviour.
Item 143: the raid spawn ring draws its angle and jitter from ServerLevel.random (26.1 drew from the raid's own random); drawing from the level random is the classic Raid.findRandomSpawnPos form.

Item 151: the /schedule queue lives in level.dat's Data.ScheduledEvents as {Name, TriggerTime, Callback} compounds (PrimaryLevelData holds the TimerQueue); the separate scheduled_events.dat SavedData is the 26.x form, and level.dat storage is classic across 1.21.x.
Item 157: the fishing-bobber texture is at the flat entity/fishing_hook path; the fishing/ subdir path is the 26.x form, and the flat path is the 1.21.x form across E6.
Item 167: the witch texture is at the flat entity/witch path and witches always throw at 0.75; the witch/ subdir and the 0.45 close-range slowdown are both 26.1 changes.

Item 173: the dragon egg teleports to the first air block inside the build height; the extra non-air-block-below requirement is a 26.1 addition, and the air-only form is the classic DragonEggBlock.teleport rule.
Item 186: drops the VillagerDataFinalized flag (the finalize gate is the spawn reason); verified via javap that the flag is absent from ZombieVillager in both 1.21.7 and 1.21.10, so it is 26.x-only.

Item 220: sapling/azalea bonemeal is always valid (SaplingBlock.isValidBonemealTarget returns true); the build-height gate via TreeGrower.getMinimumHeight is a 26.x addition (the method does not exist in 1.21.11).

Item 248: the loom scrollbar hover cursor fires only over the thumb (12x15 at x 119, y 13 + scrolled offset); checking the whole 56-tall track and gating on isScrollBarActive is the 26.1 form, and the thumb-only check is the classic LoomScreen rule.
Item 272: leaf-distance anchors on the #logs tag; the prevents_nearby_leaf_decay tag is 26.1-only (and in 26.1 holds exactly the logs), so anchoring on logs is the 1.21.x form across E6.
Item 307: spawn rules check the raw sky light (getBrightness(SKY, pos)); subtracting the sky darken via getEffectiveSkyBrightness is the 26.1 form.
Item 509: the F3 chunk-stats line includes the pU (pending uploads) field; the C:/pC:/pU:/aB: format is the classic 1.21.x debug format.
Item 523: social-screen rows show no buttons when chat is hidden (getChatStatus().isChatAllowed gate); the chat-allowed gate is the classic 1.21.x PlayerEntry behaviour.
Item 541: drops the riptide passenger gate — Riptide works while riding in 1.21.11 (only the wet check remains); blocking Riptide while riding is a 26.1 addition.
Item 614: random sequences are per-level (ServerLevel.getRandomSequences), each parked level keeping its own; per-level sequences are the classic 1.21.x form (since 1.20.2).

Item 726: block-class aliases add the classic 1.21.x class names (FarmBlock, SnowyDirtBlock, FungusBlock, RootsBlock, DirtPathBlock, RedStoneWireBlock, BedBlock, PointedDripstoneBlock) alongside the 26.x renames; the classic names are stable across all of 1.21.x.

Cuts the 26.x file-fixer system (FileFixerUpper arrived with DataVersion 4772 in 26.1) and restores the pre-26.x world layout (overworld at root, DIM-1/DIM1, level.dat WorldGenSettings); no 1.21.x version has the file fixer, so the removal applies to all of E6.
Drops the per-model `transformation` field from the item-model decode: 26.x added it to every Unbaked record, no 1.21.x version has it, so the removal applies to all of E6.
Removes the PauseMobGrowth/ResetMobGrowth particles, which are 26.x-only; no 1.21.x version registers them, so the removal applies to all of E6.
Wolf collar dyeing checks DyeItem directly instead of the #wolf_collar_dyes tag, which does not exist in 1.21.11 (26.x-only tag); vanilla 1.21.x checks DyeItem, so the fix applies to all of E6.
WorldGenSettings codec field is `generate_features`, not 26.x's `generate_structures`; all 1.21.x versions use `generate_features`, so the fix applies to all of E6.

Worldgen post-processing: mushrooms and magma mark their own position, nothing marks the block above (26.x moved magma above and added soul sand for bubble columns); the 1.21.11 form is the 1.21.x form, so it applies to all of E6.
variant_sound drops the baby branch: no baby_wolf sound events exist in either version, so baby wolves use their variant set at baby pitch; version-neutral fix, applies to all of E6.

Phantom eyes texture is flat (entity/phantom_eyes) and villager type textures have no baby/ variant (26.x added the phantom/ dir and baby/ folder); the flat layout is the 1.21.x layout, so it applies to all of E6.
Removes the bell, book and end_cube special item models, which are 26.x-only (13 special types in 1.21.11, 16 in 26.1); no 1.21.x version has them, so the removal applies to all of E6.

Implements RandomPatchFeature and IceSpikeFeature, adds the forest_rock decode, and removes the 26.x-only minecraft:spike and minecraft:block_blob types; flower/random_patch/ice_spike/forest_rock exist in all 1.21.x, so it applies to all of E6.
Note-block instruments cut 27 -> 23: the four copper trumpets are 26.x-only, and the works-above threshold moves 20 -> 16; all 1.21.x versions have 23 instruments, so it applies to all of E6.

PathType malus renames only (Damaging -> DamageOther, Fire -> DamageFire, FireInNeighbor -> DangerFire); the DANGER_*/DAMAGE_* names are the 1.21.x names (26.x renamed them), so the rename applies to all of E6.
Goal rename ClimbOnTopOfPowderSnow -> ClimbDangerPowderSnow following the PathType rename; no behaviour change, and the 1.21.x PathType names are the same across E6.

PathType uses the 1.21.x names (DangerFire/DamageFire/DangerOther/DamageOther/DangerPowderSnow/DangerTrapdoor, 26 types) and drops the 26.x-only BigMobsCloseToDanger branch; the DANGER_*/DAMAGE_* enum is the 1.21.x enum, so it applies to all of E6.
PathType malus renames only (Damaging -> DamageOther, Fire -> DamageFire, FireInNeighbor -> DangerFire); the DANGER_*/DAMAGE_* names are the 1.21.x names, so the rename applies to all of E6.
decode_noise reads the old firstOctave/amplitudes codec shape (26.3 replaced it with base_octave/octave_count/base_amplitude); all 1.21.x data uses firstOctave/amplitudes, so it applies to all of E6.

RuleBasedBlockStateProvider is a standalone record (fallback + rules, no type field, used only by DiskConfiguration) and provider types use their long registry names; 26.x promoted rule-based to a registered subtype, so the 1.21.11 form is the 1.21.x form for all of E6.

recompute_path drops the canUpdatePath gate (26.1 added it; 1.21.11 recomputes whenever 20+ ticks elapsed, the gate living only inside createPath); no 1.21.x version has the gate, so it applies to all of E6.
Removes the 26.x-only F3+4 lightmap debug key (keyDebugLightmapTexture, added in 26.1); no 1.21.x version has it, so the removal applies to all of E6.

ShareToLanScreen replaces the 26.x WorldOptionsScreen (game-mode cycle SURVIVAL/SPECTATOR/CREATIVE/ADVENTURE, port validation, publish flow); all 1.21.x versions have ShareToLanScreen with this shape, so it applies to all of E6.

Reverses the 26.x level.dat split: weather, clocks, game rules, world-gen settings, player and difficulty all live in level.dat's Data again; the split is 26.x-only, so the classic layout applies to all of E6.

Drops the 26.x bonemeal build-height guards and crop-soil tags (supports_crops/grows_crops are 26.x-only; vanilla checks farmland directly), restores the big_dripleaf_placeable tag name and the getFlowerFeatures mechanism; all are the 1.21.x forms, so they apply to all of E6.

Special recipes are hardcoded per type (26.x made them data-driven; 1.21.11 hardcodes the 13 specials with category-only files); hardcoding is the 1.21.x mechanism in all of E6. Caveat: the 13-type roster and per-type ingredients are 1.21.11's data and should be confirmed per version before propagating verbatim.

Frog lay-spawn water check: land_near_water no longer counts waterlogged blocks as water (vanilla wants an actual water block) and the TryLaySpawn citations follow the water-only class name; the water-only rule is the 1.21.x rule, so it applies to all of E6.
Banner/shield cloth textures live flat at textures/entity/ (26.x moved them under entity/banner/ and entity/shield/); the flat paths are the 1.21.x layout, so the renames apply to all of E6.

Village siege ticks in every dimension and the raid boss bar loses its Overworld gate; the TRIAGE marks both version-neutral fixes (identical in the 26.1 and 1.21.11 jars), so they apply to all of E6.
PlayerPredicate has no food field (26.1 added the 8th field with FoodPredicate); no 1.21.x version has it, so the removal applies to all of E6.
Sign-edit cursor blinks on the frame counter (frame/6%2==0), with the underscore append cursor and bar from y-1; this is AbstractSignEditScreen's long-standing behaviour, so it applies to all of E6.
Drops the bogus sleep_in_straw_bed stat (in neither jar) from the stats CUSTOM table and fixes the sort-button background/arrow offset; version-neutral corrections, so they apply to all of E6.
Drops the 26.1-only F3 sound-cache debug line and fixes device/preview citations; no 1.21.x version has the F3 sound-cache line, so the removal applies to all of E6.

Item spawn motion comes from the level random, destroyed contents use the 5-arg ctor form, and idle ticks run no block effects (applyEffectsFromBlocksForLastMovements is 26.x-only); all three are the 1.21.x forms, so they apply to all of E6.
Multi-line edit box scrolls 4.5px per wheel notch (scrollRate 9.0/2.0; 26.1 truncated it to 4 via defaultSettings(int)); the 4.5px rate is the long-standing vanilla rate, so it applies to all of E6.

Bamboo survives on the bamboo_plantable_on tag (not the 26.x supports_bamboo tag), bonemeal loses the 26.x build-height guards, and chorus-on-end-stone / kelp-refuses-magma are hardcoded; all are the 1.21.x forms, so they apply to all of E6.

Copper golem statue pose cycle (standing/sitting/running/star), waxed revert, shear event, and the double-chest sound halves (left silent, right from the middle); TRIAGE verifies the logic identical in the 26.1 and 1.21.11 jars. Scope: the golem parts propagate only to 1.21.9-1.21.10 (copper golems added in 1.21.9; absent in 1.21.5-1.21.8), the chest-sound half to all of E6.

Singleplayer options Main page shows the difficulty control (CycleButton + LockIconButton with lock confirm) instead of the Online button, sending ServerboundChangeDifficulty/LockDifficulty; the difficulty control is the 1.21.x singleplayer layout, so it applies to all of E6.
Drops the 26.1-only baby guard from animateZombieArms (baby zombies holding an item raise their arms like adults); no 1.21.x version has the guard, so it applies to all of E6.

Portal frames are checked as obsidian directly (the minecraft:nether_portal_frame tag exists in neither version's data, so fire could never light a portal); PortalShape.FRAME is state.is(OBSIDIAN) in both versions, so the version-neutral fix applies to all of E6.

NoiseRouter accepts preliminary_surface_level for the surface field and the F3 Density line falls back to the hardcoded router line in T/V/C/E/D/W/PV/PS/N order (N-first via the 26.1-only getInterpolatedNoiseValue); both are the pre-26.x forms, so they apply to all of E6.
Lead knot texture is flat at textures/entity/lead_knot.png (26.1 nested it under lead_knot/); the flat path is the 1.21.x path, so it applies to all of E6.
TurtleModel is one concrete model with an egg_belly part and no baby gate on the belly (the Adult/Baby split is 26.x); the single-model form is the 1.21.x form, so it applies to all of E6.

Block-survival rules use the 1.21.x forms: FarmBlock class name, cactus on the sand tag, farmland hardcoded fence-gate/moving-piston, lily pad on water or ice, wither rose on dirt/farmland/netherrack/soul sand/soul soil (26.1 renamed these to supports_* tags); all apply to all of E6.
Anisotropy counts only with mipmaps (mipLevel != 0); 26.1 dropped the mip check and counts it whenever filtering is anisotropic, so the guarded form is the older 1.21.x form and applies to all of E6.

Custom boss-bar UUIDs come from Mth.RANDOM (fresh random), not the level random (26.1 added a RandomSource parameter to create and drew from level.random); the Mth.RANDOM form is the older form, so it applies to all of E6.

DimensionType codec has no default_clock (the world-clock system is 26.x-only) and no has_ender_dragon_fight; both are derived from the type id (fight only in the End); no 1.21.x version has these codec fields, so it applies to all of E6.
Scoreboard saves flat at data/scoreboard.dat (not the 26.x data/minecraft/scoreboard.dat layout); the flat path is the 1.21.x layout, so it applies to all of E6.

Dispensers dispense spawn eggs via the registered SpawnEggItem behaviour instead of the default method; dispenser spawn-egg behaviour is long-standing vanilla, so it applies to all of E6 (the dragon.rs hunk is a comment fix).

Mushroom bonemeal target is always valid (26.x also required a huge-mushroom feature and build-height headroom) and the light-override tag is mushroom_grow_block (26.x renamed it overrides_mushroom_light_requirement); both are the 1.21.x forms, so they apply to all of E6.
Chorus plant/chorus flower support is end stone, hardcoded (the supports_chorus_plant tag is 26.x-only and held only end stone); the hardcoded form is the 1.21.x form, so it applies to all of E6.
Polar bear cubs hunt foxes too: the fox target goal has no selector in 1.21.11 (26.1 added a !isBaby() selector); no 1.21.x version has the selector, so it applies to all of E6.
Drops per-model transformation from the foreign item-model decode (item 108); per-model transformation is 26.x-only, so no 1.21.x version has it and the removal applies across E6.

Glowing particles use the constant light 240 and non-glowing age emission goes to the sky channel (item 192), and the 26.x-only pause/reset mob-growth particles are removed (item 311); both are the pre-26.x vanilla forms shared across E6.
Cauldron dye-removal reads the `dyeable` tag instead of `cauldron_can_remove_dye` (item 263); 26.x renamed the tag with identical contents, so the dyeable name is the 1.21-era form.
GameTest bounds lose the 26.x-only test-instance padding (item 154); 1.21.x has no padding, so the unpadded bounds apply across E6.
Age-lock particle emission is removed (item 311): the pause/reset growth particles and AgeableMob.makeAgeLockedParticle are 26.x-only, so no 1.21.x version emits them.
Removes the baby-horse eat sound (item 320): 1.21.11 has no baby-horse events at all (26.1 added entity.horse.*_baby), so babies use the adult sound at pitch across E6.
Removes the baby-horse land sound (item 320): no baby-horse events exist in 1.21.x, so babies fall through to the adult horse land sound across E6.
Restores the vanilla 1.21-era texture paths (entity/llama/creamy, entity/phantom, items 344/345); the 26.x llama_ prefix and phantom/ directory are 26.x-only.
Module wiring for the ice_spike and random_patch features (item 361) and removal of the 26.x-only spike module; both features are vanilla features present across E6.
Implements vanilla IceSpikeFeature (packed-ice spikes on a snow-block footing, item 361); the feature exists across E6 and 26.x only generalized it into the config-driven spike type.

PathType renames to the 1.21.11 names (DangerFire/DamageFire/DangerOther/DamageOther/DangerPowderSnow) with the jar-verified constructor maluses (item 383); the 26.x names are renames of the long-standing 1.21-era enum.
Same PathType rename as ai.rs (Fire -> DamageFire) in the block path-type lookup (item 383); the 1.21-era names apply across E6.
Llama decor renders the carpet on babies too and always uses the trader_llama blanket (item 379); skipping equipment on babies and the trader_llama_baby asset are 26.x-only.
Goal rename ClimbOnTopOfPowderSnow -> ClimbDangerPowderSnow (item 383), the PathType rename follow-through; behaviour unchanged.
Shift density functions read the offset noise from `argument` (item 386), the 1.21.11 single-argument codec form, keeping the 26.3 `noise` field as fallback; the argument form is the 1.21-era codec.

Adds the long-name BlockStateProvider type arms (noise_provider, noise_threshold_provider, dual_noise_provider, item 401); the long names are the 1.21-era registry names and the short names are 26.x renames.

Baby zombified piglin dimensions become the adult 0.6 x 1.95 scaled 0.5 (0.3 x 0.975, eye 0.97, item 430); 26.1's own BABY_DIMENSIONS is a 26.x change, and the 0.5 scale is the long-standing vanilla rule.
Chat gating rests on ChatStatus (item 11); the ChatAbilities/ChatRestriction system is 26.x-only, and 1.21.x gates opening chat on visibility and sends whatever is typed once open.

Mob behaviour fixes (item 12: mooshroom flower-feeding loses its adult gate, dolphin FollowBoat, goat horn/ram rules, sheep ate on is_baby, baby glow squid adult model, flattened texture paths, flame light 240); all are the 1.21-era vanilla forms, not 1.21.11 additions.

Block-entity texture-path moves to the 1.21-era names (end_portal, beacon_beam, end_gateway_beam, enchanting_table_book, item 16) and copper chests wear the christmas textures; the copper arm only engages in 1.21.9+ (copper chests were added in 1.21.9) and is inert in 1.21.5-1.21.8.

Escape closes the Optimize screen (26.1's shouldCloseOnEsc=false override is 26.x-only; no such override in the 1.21.10 jar) and the FileFixerUpper system is removed (item 21); FileFixerUpper is absent from the 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 jars, so it is 26.x-only.

Drops the 26.x per-species baby textures, restores the 1.21-era variant names (snow_fox, bare rabbit names, gene pandas, climate pig/cow/chicken/frog, red/brown mooshroom) and renders equipment on babies (item 25); the kept nautilus/happy-ghast baby textures are inert where those mobs do not exist (nautilus is 1.21.11-only, verified absent from the 1.21.7/1.21.10 jars; happy ghast is 1.21.6+).
The dedicated server no longer saves at startup (item 31); the saveEverything at the end of DedicatedServer.initServer is 26.1-only, so 1.21.x servers first write at the first autosave or stop.
Extruded-sprite side UVs scale minV by xScale and maxU by yScale (item 37), the classic vanilla createSideElements quirk; 26.x's per-axis scaling is the change, so the swapped form applies across E6.

Drops the exclusiveFullscreen option (item 42); it has zero references in the 1.21.11 jar and is absent from the 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 Options classes, so fullscreen-always-preferred-mode is the 1.21-era behaviour (the options.fullscreen.resolution caption key exists in 1.21.10's lang).

NeutralMob anger restarts the timer every tick a target is held, with no Peaceful/creative forgiveness (item 47); the 26.1 new-target-only restart and forgiveness checks are 26.x changes to the long-standing NeutralMob form.
Block states no definition covers draw the missing cube (item 52, ModelManager.createBlockStateToModelDispatch fills every state); long-standing vanilla behaviour, not a 1.21.11 addition.

Special item renderers apply their inline transform in submit/getExtents (item 56) because per-model transformation is 26.x-only; codec shapes verified in the 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 jars (shulker orientation present; banner has no attachment, chest has no chest_type).
panic_environmental_causes is the 1.21.11 seven (item 62); sulfur_cube_hot is no damage type in 1.21.11 (nor in 26.1), so the seven-member tag is the 1.21-era form.

Armor stand texture is wood.png (armorstand.png is 26.1), brokenByAnything drops all equipment (the vanishing check is 26.1-only) and there is no humanoid_baby armor layer (item 67); all are the 1.21-era forms.
A disc naming an unknown song shows no jukebox tooltip line (item 90, EitherHolder.unwrap fails); the raw-key fallback was the 26.x form, and the unwrap-failure behaviour is the 1.21-era form.

The fluid standing shape is the fixed bottom-half SHAPE_STABLE and LiquidBlock bubble-column scheduling is removed (item 97); the per-entity liquid shape and the 20-tick bubble-column scheduling are 26.1-only.

Trim material unwraps against the loaded trim-material registry (item 104, TrimMaterials.getFromIngredient EitherHolder unwrap fails for unknown named materials); the registry validation is the 1.21-era form.

A framed map widens the item-frame hitbox face to a full block (item 112); the TRIAGE confirms the bounding-box rule (0.75 face / 1.0 with a framed map) is identical in 26.1 and 1.21.11, so this is a Rust bug fix, not a version delta.
Saving a book drops every trailing empty page (item 125, BookEditScreen.eraseEmptyTrailingPages); the Java delta is rename-only, so the rule is version-independent across E6.
set_enchantments adds to the existing level when `add` is set and clamps every level to 0..255 (item 129, SetEnchantmentsFunction.run); the 1.21-era loot-function form.
Strider suffocation is cold unless in warm blocks, or riding a cold strider whose cold spreads to the rider (item 136); 26.1's rule (a warm mount keeps the rider warm) is the 26.x change.
Cooking recipes use per-kind cook times (smelting 200, blasting/smoking/campfire 100) and single-item results (item 147); the long-standing vanilla defaults and the STRICT_SINGLE_ITEM_CODEC form.
Brain sensor first-scan delays are drawn from the brain seed, mirroring the static Sensor.RANDOM (item 153); drawing them from the mob's random via randomlyDelayStart is 26.1-only.
fetchprofile has no `entity` branch (item 160, 26.1 added it) and NbtContents prints a string tag raw and anything else as compact SNBT; 26.1's rich-styled rendering and `plain` flag are 26.x-only.
Baby chested horses and llamas use their own passenger attachments from BABY_DIMENSIONS (item 169, donkey 0.671875 / mule 0.721875 / llama 0.52875); the 1.21-era attachment form.
Bubble-column blocks are hardcoded (item 178): soul sand pushes up, magma drags down, columns exist in source water; the enables_bubble_column_* and bubble_column_can_occupy tags are 26.x-only.
The tripwire hook emits unconditionally (item 196); the 26.1 check for the near hook having vanished during the far hook's notification is 26.x-only.
Dripstone grows only under a water source BLOCK two above (item 230, PointedDripstoneBlock.canGrow); waterlogged fluid alone does not count, and the rule is stable since 1.17.
The /clone area check multiplies the spans as wrapping 32-bit ints (item 267); 26.1 widens the product to long, so the wrapping quirk is the 1.21-era form.
EditGameRulesScreen is creation-only (item 292); the search box, the InWorldGameRulesScreen split and the 36-pixel header are all 26.1 additions, and 1.21.x has no in-world game-rules screen.

The dragon fight state lives in level.dat's DragonFight compound (item 483); the separate data/minecraft/ender_dragon_fight.dat file is the 26.x form, and level.dat storage is the long-standing vanilla form.

The debug chart footer is one line (Profiler / FPS[+TPS] / Ping[+Bandwidth]) with the FPS casing fix and the performance-impactors spacing (item 519); the 26.1 three-line formatChart form is a 26.x refactor, and the FPS casing is vanilla in both versions.

The wandering trader clock lives in level.dat (WanderingTraderSpawnDelay/SpawnChance/Id) and the spawn height uses the WORLD_SURFACE heightmap (item 535); both are the long-standing vanilla forms, and the 26.x separate file and MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES heightmap are 26.x changes.

The debug overlay appends the day to Local Difficulty, labels memory MB (not MiB) and joins the sound mood with two spaces (item 571); these are the 1.21-era F3 formats, and the 26.1 DayCount entry split and MiB labels are 26.x changes.
A loaded shipwreck re-adjusts on every postProcess (item 640); the height_adjusted flag that makes it run once is a 26.1 addition, so the re-adjusting form is the 1.21-era behaviour.
Baby axolotls use the same procedural pose as adults (item 779); the Adult/Baby model split with keyframe clips for babies is 26.1-only.
Suffocation fixtures follow the motion-based rule (causes_suffocation tag removed). The tag is absent from all six E6 jars and 1.21.7 already uses MotionFullCollision, so the rule is the E6 form.

Removes six 26.x-only data component types (dye, additional_trade_cost, cat/chicken/cow/pig sound variants); only wolf/sound_variant exists in E6. DataComponents in 1.21.6-1.21.10 has only WOLF_SOUND_VARIANT and the 1.21.5 strings agree.

Drops the 26.x-only test-instance padding from structure-block bounds. TestInstanceBlockEntity has no padding field in any E6 jar.
Removes the 26.x-only age-lock pause/reset particles from Tadpole.aiStep, keeping only the timer. E6 Tadpole has no age-lock particle code (only the HAPPY_VILLAGER grow-up burst).
Slot range is 'villager.' not 'mob.inventory.'. SlotRanges has 'villager.' in 1.21.6-1.21.10 and 'mob.inventory.' is absent from all six E6 jars (1.21.5 included).
blocks_attacks.bypassed_by is a TagKey, not a HolderSet, on the wire. BlocksAttacks.bypassedBy is Optional<TagKey<DamageType>> in all five named E6 jars.
Removes 26.x-only baby-horse and pig-eat sounds from the mob AI probe. SoundEvents has no baby-horse or entity.pig.eat entries in 1.21.6-1.21.10.
Command-storage data uses the 'command_storage_' id prefix. The prefix string is present in all six E6 client jars and the 1.21.7-1.21.10 server jars.
Drops the 26.x-only bell/book/end_cube special model renderers (16 types in 26.1, 13 in 1.21.11). SpecialModelRenderers has no bell/book/end_cube strings in any E6 jar.
BlockBlobFeature takes a plain BlockStateConfiguration (no can_place_on). The E6 BlockBlobFeature constructor takes the same BlockStateConfiguration codec in all five named jars.
Restores the 1.21.11 RandomPatchFeature form. RandomPatchFeature exists with its RandomPatchConfiguration in all E6 jars.
PathType rename to the 1.21.11 fire/damage family (DANGER_FIRE etc.). All six E6 jars have the same PathType constants (javap in 1.21.6-1.21.10, string scan in 1.21.5).

PathType rename to the 1.21.11 fire/damage family (DANGER_FIRE etc.); the fox goal rename follows PathType. All six E6 jars have the same PathType constants (javap in 1.21.6-1.21.10, string scan in 1.21.5).
PathType rename to the 1.21.11 fire/damage family (DANGER_FIRE etc.). All six E6 jars have the same PathType constants (javap in 1.21.6-1.21.10, string scan in 1.21.5).

Legacy noise wiring gated on useLegacyRandomSource, with hardcoded NoiseParameters(-7, [1.0, 1.0]) temperature/vegetation samplers recreated per lookup. RandomState$1NoiseWiringHelper in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10 has the identical legacy branch, and nether.json has legacy_random_source: true in all six versions.
BlockStateJsonCodec reads the NBT field names (Name/Properties) in the full form. StateHolder's codec uses only Name/Properties in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10 (no bare 'id' string).
Spectator spectate-hit-entity behaviour restored; ancient vanilla behaviour, version-independent across E6.

Realms slot-name truncation to 64px (plainSubstrByWidth + '...') and the row-based SlotOptions layout. RealmsWorldSlotButton has WORLD_NAME_MAX_WIDTH/DOTS with bipush 64 in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10, and RealmsSlotOptionsScreen has no HeaderAndFooterLayout in any E6 jar.
Removes the 26.x-only ChatAbilities handling from chat. The ChatAbilities class is absent from all five named E6 jars.

Vegetation on dirt-or-farmland and stems on farmland (supports_vegetation/supports_small_dripleaf tags absent in all six E6 jars; small_dripleaf_placeable present), plus the narration hint after the title: Screen.updateNarrationState in 1.21.6/1.21.10 narrates TITLE, then USAGE when shouldNarrateNavigation, then the widget - the same order.

Restores the classic fluid-pushing forms (updateInWaterStateAndDoFluidPushing / updateFluidHeightAndDoFluidPushing). Entity has both methods in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10, with no 26.x updateFluidInteraction/getFluidInteractionBox/belowNameDisplay.

Glowing-particle light is the constant 240, flame emission goes to the block channel, GlowParticle is translucent. ShriekParticle.getLightColor returns 240, FlameParticle adds the age fraction to the block channel, and GlowParticle is TRANSLUCENT in all E6 versions (explicit render type in 1.21.6-1.21.8, Layer.TRANSLUCENT in 1.21.9-1.21.10).

Fox baby scale 0.5 with 0.2975 eye height, crouch cap 3.0, plain pounce pitch (signum/acos, no 6.5x bias). Fox BABY_DIMENSIONS is 0.5f/0.2975f, the crouch clamps at 3.0f, and FoxPounceGoal uses Math.signum/Math.acos with no 6.5 constant in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Temptation sets the IS_TEMPTED memory. MemoryModuleType.IS_TEMPTED exists and FollowTemptation references it in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.

Cat lie/sit tags replaced by their 1.21.11 equivalents, no baby wolf/feline models, no TamableAnimal.feed, flat WolfSoundVariant record, no sound-variant inheritance on breeding. The tags and baby models are absent in all E6 jars, TamableAnimal has no feed method, WolfSoundVariant is the same six-holder record, and Wolf has no setSoundVariant calls in 1.21.6/1.21.10.

Dying-dragon two-pass render (dragonExplosionAlpha + entityDecal), no knockback override, death tick == 200, dragon respawn/spike renames. RenderType has both passes, EnderDragon has no knockback override and its tickDeath spans the 180-200 window with the == 200 orb spawn, and DragonRespawnStage/EndSpikeFeature are absent in all E6 jars.
WaterlilyBlock is the 1.21.11 name (LilyPadBlock is the 26.x rename). WaterlilyBlock is present and LilyPadBlock absent in all five named E6 jars.

Restores LiquidBlockRenderer and the float putBulkData forms (BlockModelLighter/FluidRenderer are 26.x-only). BlockModelLighter and FluidRenderer are absent and LiquidBlockRenderer present in all E6 jars, and VertexConsumer.putBulkData takes floats in 1.21.6-1.21.10.

Baby zombies use the half-size box (ZOMBIE scaled 0.5, eye 0.93); drowned and zombie villagers define no BABY_DIMENSIONS of their own. Zombie.BABY_DIMENSIONS is built from 0.5f with eye 0.93f in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10, and Drowned/ZombieVillager have no BABY_DIMENSIONS.
Soul sand checks for a bubble column above (onPlace/updateShape/tick). SoulSandBlock has all three methods in 1.21.6-1.21.10 and updateShape schedules the tick.
Removes MountPanicGoal (horses use plain PanicGoal) and the baby horse/donkey models. AbstractHorse registers plain PanicGoal and BabyHorseModel/BabyDonkeyModel are absent in all E6 jars.
Bundle weight is the 1.21.11 formula (nested-bundle weight, beehive bees, count/max). BundleContents.getWeight references BUNDLE_CONTENTS, BEES and getMaxStackSize in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.

Sculk growth placement counts sensors/shriekers directly (no sculk_growth_inhibitors tag). The tag is absent from all six E6 jars and SculkBlock references SCULK_SENSOR/SCULK_SHRIEKER directly in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Removes the 26.x-only baby axolotl animation and baby dimensions. BabyAxolotlAnimation is absent from all five named E6 jars and Axolotl has no BABY_DIMENSIONS in 1.21.6-1.21.10.
Warden disturbance placement gates on the world border. WardenAi.setDisturbanceLocation calls getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(BlockPos) in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Zombies do not heal on attribute application. Zombie.handleAttributes has no setHealth call in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.

WeightedList.isEmpty is items.isEmpty(); flame/glow emission is the inlined 15*16 form on the block channel and portal light goes to the sky channel (age^4). WeightedList.isEmpty reads items.isEmpty(), FlameParticle adds to the block channel and PortalParticle adds the age^4 fraction to the sky channel in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.

Rabbit jumps are the flat forward push (moveRelative 0.1, Vec3(0,0,1)) with a 10-tick jump duration and no BABY_DIMENSIONS. Rabbit.jumpFromGround and startJumping (jumpDuration = 10) are identical in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10, and Rabbit has no BABY_DIMENSIONS.
Removes the 26.x-only SniffletModel; the sniffer baby transform stays. SniffletModel is absent from all five named E6 jars while SnifferAnimation.BABY_TRANSFORM exists in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Item-command error strings use the 1.21.11 forms ('damageable and stackable', 'larger than maximum'). Both strings are present in all six E6 jars.
Baby camels scale 0.45. Camel.getAgeScale returns 0.45f in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.

Difficulty ids wrap (ByIdMap WRAP) and allowCommands defaults to creative mode. Difficulty.byId uses OutOfBoundsStrategy.WRAP and LevelSettings.parse defaults allowCommands on CREATIVE in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
The accessibility onboarding screen is the 3-button column with no Sounds button (26.1 added one). AccessibilityOnboardingScreen has no options.sounds/Sounds references in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Portal ticket storage uses the 'chunks' id (no chunk_tickets). TicketStorage's id is 'chunks' in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10 and 'chunk_tickets' is absent from all six E6 jars.

Golem stroll draws the 0.7 roll first and the 0.3 roll second, and snow-layer survival uses the snow_layer_can/cannot_survive_on tags. GolemRandomStrollInVillageGoal.getPosition stores the first nextFloat and compares 0.3 second in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10, and both tags are present in all six E6 jars.
Trees use the dirt_provider (TrunkPlacer.setDirtAt). TreeConfiguration.dirtProvider and TrunkPlacer.setDirtAt exist in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.

LeadItem.bindPlayerMobs makes the knot on the first leashable mob before the attach check, so a fence keeps its knot and sound even when nothing attaches. The E6 bindPlayerMobs body is identical: getOrCreateKnot + playPlacementSound on the first leashable, then canHaveALeashAttachedTo per mob, in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Creeper SwellGoal has no isDeadOrDying gate. SwellGoal references no isDeadOrDying in 1.21.6 and 1.21.10.
Removes the 26.x-only baby axolotl animation. BabyAxolotlAnimation is absent from all five named E6 jars.
